Based on the image provided, here are the answers to your questions:

*   **Is there a scope overlay?** **Yes.** The image features a distinct circular scope view with black borders (vignetting) surrounding it. You can also see the thin crosshair lines of a reticle dividing the circle into quadrants.
*   **Is the weapon viewmodel hidden or visible?** **Hidden.** There is no visible gun model in this screenshot. This is standard behavior for many first-person shooters when scoped in with a sniper rifle to provide an unobstructed view.
*   **Is the view zoomed in?** **Yes.** The view is heavily zoomed in, as indicated by the close-up texture of what appears to be a wall or ground surface filling the entire circular viewport.
*   **Any glitches?** **No obvious glitches.** The image appears to be a clean screenshot of a game's round-end screen (specifically from *Counter-Strike 2*) while the player was still in a scoped state. The UI overlay ("TERRORISTS WIN") is rendering correctly on top of the scope view.
